description: Generate a robots.txt file with specified blocked bots, sitemap URLs, and custom rules.

block_all_ai.description: If true, blocks all known AI crawlers (but not search engines like Googlebot)

blocked_bots.description: Array of bot user-agent strings to block (e.g. ['GPTBot', 'ClaudeBot', 'CCBot']). Use list_ai_bots to see available user-agents.

custom_rules.description: Additional custom robots.txt rules to append (raw robots.txt syntax)

sitemap_urls.description: Array of sitemap URLs to include (e.g. ['https://example.com/sitemap.xml'])

name: generate_robots
